checkpoint_review: The Router was generally accurate but slightly lenient on the 'Label area' checkpoint. It marked it as present because a label exists, but failed to penalize the fact that the text is illegible gibberish, which violates the taxonomy requirement for 'track information'. The Router correctly identified the missing second spool window as a failure of the 'Two circular holes' checkpoint. The 'Rectangular opening' checkpoint was correctly marked untestable/false due to occlusion, though in AI generation, this often implies the feature wasn't generated at all.
artifact_review: The Router underestimated the severity of the 'structural_collapse' (missing right window). In a rigid object like a cassette, missing a fundamental symmetrical component is a catastrophic structural failure, not just a minor geometric error. I am upgrading this severity from 2 to 4. The 'text_gibberish' is also severe; the image_text_auditor found ZERO legible text blocks, confirming the label is purely hallucinated texture. This is a high-severity artifact for a product shot. The 'texture_anomaly' of the blue spool is also noted as a clear hallucination.
alignment_reasoning: While the fine_grained_classifier confidently identifies the object as a 'cassette' (Top-1), this is misleading. The object fails critical structural checkpoints: it lacks the mandatory second spool window and the internal mechanics are nonsensical (blue blob). The label fails to provide required information. The alignment is low because the object is structurally incomplete despite having the general shape and color palette of a cassette.
artifact_reasoning: Multiple severe artifacts detected. 1) Structural Collapse: The right-side spool window is completely missing/fused into the casing (Severity 4). 2) Text Gibberish: The label contains no readable text, only distorted patterns (Severity 4). 3) Texture Anomaly: The visible spool hub is an unnatural blue/purple gradient lacking mechanical detail (Severity 3). 4) Perspective/Melting: Edges are soft and the write-protect tab is ill-defined. These defects indicate a significant failure in generating a rigid, manufactured object.
